description: Define cómo evaluar el progreso del estudiante de manera formativa, alineado con las 8 dimensiones cognitivas de module_steps
assessment_philosophy: La evaluación debe orientar el siguiente paso de aprendizaje, no etiquetar ni clasificar al estudiante. Los resultados indican necesidades, no deficiencias.

assessment_dimensions.what_it_measures: Conocimientos previos e intuiciones sobre el concepto
assessment_dimensions.mastery_signal: Identifica elementos clave sin explicación previa
assessment_dimensions.struggle_signal: Respuestas al azar o confusión sobre qué observar

assessment_dimensions.what_it_measures: Capacidad de interpretar representaciones visuales del concepto
assessment_dimensions.struggle_signal: No puede interpretar el visual o confunde elementos
assessment_dimensions.adaptive_action_if_struggling: Show labeled visual or provide concept_card

assessment_dimensions.what_it_measures: Capacidad de explicar por qué funciona el concepto
assessment_dimensions.struggle_signal: Solo repite procedimiento sin explicar por qué

assessment_dimensions.what_it_measures: Capacidad de distinguir ejemplos de no-ejemplos del concepto
assessment_dimensions.struggle_signal: Confunde casos similares o usa criterio incorrecto

assessment_dimensions.what_it_measures: Capacidad de aplicar el concepto con apoyo
assessment_dimensions.struggle_signal: Requiere múltiples hints o comete errores de procedimiento

assessment_dimensions.what_it_measures: Capacidad de aplicar el concepto en contexto nuevo
assessment_dimensions.mastery_signal: Identifica cómo aplicar concepto en situación no vista
assessment_dimensions.struggle_signal: No reconoce concepto en nuevo contexto
assessment_dimensions.adaptive_action_if_struggling: Highlight connection to previous context, then retry

assessment_dimensions.what_it_measures: Capacidad de detectar y explicar misconceptions
assessment_dimensions.mastery_signal: Identifica error y explica por qué es incorrecto
assessment_dimensions.struggle_signal: No detecta error o lo justifica incorrectamente

assessment_dimensions.what_it_measures: Capacidad de reflexionar sobre el propio proceso de aprendizaje
assessment_dimensions.mastery_signal: Articula qué estrategia usó y cómo la aplicaría de nuevo
assessment_dimensions.struggle_signal: Respuesta vaga ('No sé') o no puede identificar estrategia
assessment_dimensions.adaptive_action_if_struggling: Prompt with specific questions ('¿Qué te ayudó más: el dibujo o el ejemplo?')

strong_mastery.definition: Student demonstrates understanding across multiple dimensions
strong_mastery.adaptive_action: Offer challenge variant or allow skip to next module

developing_mastery.definition: Student understands core concept but struggles with transfer or error detection
developing_mastery.adaptive_action: Provide more practice in transfer contexts, show worked examples

emerging_understanding.definition: Student grasps basic idea but needs significant support
emerging_understanding.adaptive_action: Insert remedial steps, provide concept_cards, simplify language

not_yet.definition: Student shows persistent misconception or lack of prerequisite knowledge
signals: Cannot explain reasoning even after support
not_yet.adaptive_action: Diagnose prerequisite gap, offer simpler module first, or flag for human teacher

misconception_detection.what_are_misconceptions: Systematic errors that reveal incorrect mental models, not random mistakes
how_to_detect: Pattern of same error across multiple contexts
Confusion between related concepts (e.g., área vs perímetro)

matematicas: Area and perimeter are the same
You can add fractions by adding numerators and denominators separately
ciencias: Heavy objects fall faster than light objects
Seasons are caused by Earth's distance from sun

misconception_detection.action_when_misconception_detected: Show corrective_card that names the misconception and explains correct concept

formative_assessment.how_used: Adaptive engine adjusts next_step_logic based on performance
formative_assessment.visible_to_student: As feedback and hints, not as grades

summative_assessment.visible_to_student: As progress indicator, not as judgment

formative_vs_summative.kuneo_priority: Formative assessment is primary; summative is secondary and optional

what_to_track.purpose: Identify which students need more support

decision_points.action: Strong mastery signal → allow skip to next module or offer challenge
Insert remedial step or simplify problem
Provide worked_example, then ask to explain a similar problem
Metacognition opportunity: prompt reflection on how they identified it

show: Badges or milestones for completing units
Which students are struggling on which dimensions
do_not_show: Fixed labels ('This student is weak at math')

show: What concepts child is working on
Areas of strength and areas needing support

poor_assessment_practice: Same instruction for everyone regardless of performance

alignment_with_men_lineamientos.evaluacion_formativa: Priorizar evaluación que orienta, no que clasifica
alignment_with_men_lineamientos.evaluacion_continua: Cada module_step genera evidencia, no solo test final
alignment_with_men_lineamientos.autoevaluacion: Metacognition step (8) promueve autoevaluación del estudiante
